citations.F1: `serialize_event` runs a separate `SELECT ... FROM users` per event, awaited one at a time — for acme that's ~1,900 sequential round-trips per request. Batch actor lookups with one `WHERE id = ANY($1)`
citations.F2: dedupe checks `dedupe_key in seen` against a growing list (O(n²)) ... Use a `set` for the seen-check
citations.F3: `lookup_geo` calls `requests.get` (sync, blocking) inside an async handler ... Switch to an async HTTP client (`httpx.AsyncClient`) or take geo resolution off the request path entirely.
citations.F4: Add a composite index on `events(org_id, created_at DESC)` — there's no index covering this WHERE/ORDER BY, so it's scanning all 4.2M rows per request
citations.F5: bound `_request_timings` (ring buffer/reservoir) since `/internal/metrics` still needs to read it
citations.F6: `_geo_cache` and `_request_timings` are module-level and never evict ... Cap `_geo_cache` (LRU/TTL)
citations.F9: Re-measure after 2-6 before touching worker/pool counts — once the blocking call and N+1 are gone, 4 workers/10 conns may already be enough; only raise concurrency if profiling still shows contention.
citations.F11: `since` defaults to `datetime.now()` computed per request, so unless the mobile client pins `since`, the cache key differs every call
